forcePoint: world-horizontal at torso/hip origin, not torso COM
normalScope: Local grounded recovery, no wheel-contact loss. This is a declared teaching task, not every physically recoverable disturbance.

selection.method: Largest contiguous all-pass prefix of the fixed amplitude screen; normal amplitude is 80 percent of its upper tested point, rounded downward to 0.1 N.

claimBoundary: Existing 40N/0.2s and original 3N/0.1s receipts are retained. Adjusting the force creates a new operating task; it does not solve or erase the old 40N failure. New noise seeds on the same physical model, not hardware or physical OOD.
